page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; below the text a decorative woodcut ornament, without text; at the lower right the catchword.

main_text.p: plicat præcedentem partem quæ per terram repe-bat, propellens in locum ejus subit, præcedens verò se contrahens antrorsum sinum novum facit. Et quamvis in aquæ fluxu lento, hi motus diversi partium non sint manifesti. cùm tamen fluxus est rapi-dior, adeò sunt conspicui, ut undæ alternatim sese arcuantes, tum in rectam sese solventes serpentis formam referant. Atque tunc accidit, ut, quod in arcu valde curvato cernimus, impetu scilicet majori se relaxare, ita partes illæ aquarum magis compressæ validiori pulsa præcedentes submoveant, hocque pacto fluxus evadat velocior.
Porrò spiritus ille qui è partibus compressis exprimitur, vicissim eas repetens ipsarum efficit proten-sionem. Quod de aqua, idem de ignis fluxu servata proportione capiendum.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is decorative and has no printed words, so it is not transcribed. A small mark below the ornament is a speck, not text. The catchword "DE" is at the lower right. No signature is printed on this page.
